description: INDEX of UK local planning authorities, their online planning portals and the portal software vendor. One small row per authority: enough to resolve a council to a portal and a recipe, and to decide whether an automated run is worth attempting at all (`scriptable`). Everything specific to an authority - endpoints, parameters, headers, quirks, pacing, bot protection, browser routes, verification history - lives in the per-authority profile named by `detail`, and is read ONLY for the authority in play. Derived from those profiles; edit a profile, not this file. Consumed by the planning-document-search skill, and usable independently - authorities/_schema.json is the contract.
contributing: To add or update an authority: resolve the portal + vendor (index first, then PlanIt), apply the vendor recipe end-to-end, verify at least one real download by magic bytes, then write authorities/<slug>.json against _schema.json and update this index to match it. Vendor-level method belongs in SKILL.md's recipes, never in a profile; cohort-scoping rules belong in the profile's `cohort_scope` key, never in `retrieval`.

status_values.untested: Portal URL/vendor recorded but no document download has been attempted yet.
status_values.browser-only: Reachable only via a real browser session (bot protection / SPA defeats plain HTTP); document which browser route worked.
status_values.blocked: Could not retrieve documents by any available route in-session; see specializations for the blocker.
status_values.partial: Search/metadata works but document download does not, or only some docs retrievable.
status_values.broken: Portal URL dead / moved / vendor changed; needs re-discovery.

difficulty_values.routine: The vendor recipe as written works unmodified.
difficulty_values.quirky: Works, but needs the per-authority quirks recorded in the profile.
difficulty_values.fragile: Works intermittently - timeouts, rate limits, partial failures. Expect retries.
difficulty_values.browser-only: No plain-HTTP route. Hand the user the profile's browser_route.
difficulty_values.blocked: No route found by any means in-session.

conventions.scriptable: Whether documents can be downloaded by a plain HTTP client. The field an automated caller branches on: false for browser-only, blocked and broken.

resolution.how: Resolve a council to its portal URL + vendor with GET /api/areas/json?area_type=planning&auths=<name> ; each area record carries `planning_url` (portal base) and `scraper_type` (vendor family). Resolve a reference to its council application URL with GET /api/applics/json?id_match=<ref> ; the `url` field is the deep link into the council portal. Set an identifying User-Agent (403 on bad/absent UA) and back off on 429 (honour Retry-After).
resolution.notes: PlanIt returns the council application URL but NOT direct document file links — follow `url` into the portal and apply the vendor recipe to enumerate/download documents. planning.data.gov.uk is spatial/policy constraints only (Article 4, conservation areas, listed buildings, local plans), NOT an application-document source.
static_lists: https://github.com/digital-land/organisation-dataset (canonical LPA identity + GSS codes; no portal URLs)
